H1_memo_generalization.description: On memo-present rows of C2 (held-out novel typologies), S4 achieves competitive or higher PR-AUC and recall.

H2_false_block_control.description: S4 false block rate does not exceed S2 false block rate by more than 0.50 percentage points on C1.

H3_memo_absent_equivalence.description: On all memo-absent transactions, S4 actions are strictly identical to S2 actions.

H6_device_feature_contribution.description: Ablation confirms device context features yield a meaningful ROC-AUC lift.
